description: Implementation of the service interface for retrieving post-dated checks related to loans, including methods to get lists of checks, individual checks by ID, and checks by installment ID. It interacts with repositories and performs filters to exclude bounced checks.

classes.name: RepaymentWithPostDatedChecksReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to retrieve post-dated check data related to loans, interacting with repositories and filtering checks based on status.

methods.name: getPostDatedChecks
methods.description: Retrieves a list of post-dated checks for a specific loan ID, excluding bounced checks.

methods.name: getPostDatedCheck
methods.description: Retrieves a single post-dated check by its ID.

methods.name: getPostDatedCheckByInstallmentId
methods.description: Retrieves a post-dated check associated with a specific installment ID and loan ID, excluding bounced checks.
